description: Public Utilities Sri Lanka Electricity Act, No. 20 of 2009 (Amended) issuance of Certificate of Exemption
reasoning: This gazette contains a legal/regulatory notice issued by the Public Utilities Commission of Sri Lanka under Section 10(3) of the Sri Lanka Electricity Act, No. 20 of 2009 (Amended), granting certificates of exemption from licensing requirements for electricity distribution and supply. It involves regulatory frameworks, statutory instruments, and compliance requirements rather than government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other specialized categories.
